adminNotSet: No address saved. Paste the secret address of your calendar in the settings above, then save.
adminSaved: Address saved (site: {host}). It is never shown again.
adminOk: Calendar read: {n} event(s) in the next 30 days ({cancelled} cancelled, not counted).
adminStale: The last read failed ({reason}): the previous copy is kept for now.
testOk: The address works: {n} upcoming event(s) in the next 30 days.
err_url: This address is not allowed: use a public https:// address.
err_network: The calendar could not be reached (service down, or too slow).
err_http: The calendar service refused the request (code {status}): wrong address, or the calendar became private. Copy the complete secret address again.
err_format: This address does not give an iCal calendar: check that it is the “Secret address in iCal format” (it ends with .ics).
err_size: This calendar is too large (5 MB at most).
